data_access_basis: Published survey subgroup aggregates only; no person-level or channel-level profile collection
population: U.S. adults 18+ in Pew's 2026 National Public Opinion Reference Survey, collected January 30–June 18 via web/mail/phone

race_ethnicity_groups.label: White
race_ethnicity_groups.eligible_population: U.S. adults reporting White as their only race and not Hispanic

race_ethnicity_groups.label: Hispanic
race_ethnicity_groups.eligible_population: U.S. adults reporting Hispanic identity, of any race

race_ethnicity_groups.label: Black
race_ethnicity_groups.eligible_population: U.S. adults reporting Black as their only race and not Hispanic

race_ethnicity_groups.label: Asian (English speakers only)
race_ethnicity_groups.eligible_population: Non-Hispanic single-race Asian U.S. adult English speakers; not representative of all Asian-language populations

religious_affiliation.permissible_next_step: Independently locate and review a survey explicitly measuring both YouTube behavior and self-reported religious affiliation in a legally publishable, appropriately sampled aggregate frame

publication_limits: Race/ethnicity classification comes only from published respondent self-identification; never infer an individual attribute from face, skin tone, voice, name, country, language or comments.
These are percentages of adults WITHIN each named race/ethnicity group reporting ever-use, not proportions of all YouTube users.
Single-race non-Hispanic categories and Hispanic-of-any-race categories are defined differently but are grouped as reported by the source; no recoding or inferred identity.
The Asian estimate is representative of English speakers only and is not a general all-language Asian population rate.
The survey-wide sample size and ±1.8 point margin cannot be assigned to every race/ethnicity cell; their subgroup sample sizes and errors are unknown.
Published U.S. adults exclude children and cannot yield YouTube global, regional or creator-population ethnicity distributions.
Ever use does not mean monthly active, a specific format or community membership, political affiliation or spending.
Religious identity and religious belief of YouTube users are unmeasured and may not be inferred from the topic of videos, creators' names, comments, emojis or channel aesthetics.
Exclude person-level profiling, reidentification and lists of users inferred to belong to protected categories.
Use licensed/released aggregate respondent data only; apply consent and age safeguards for any future collection.
